personality_one_liner: An earthy, reflective, and human-made experience focused on environmental awareness and action.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous, calming whitespace. Avoid dense clustering. Use soft vertical rhythm similar to a scrapbook or journal.

dont's: Do not use blur or glass effects in this personality as it clashes with the organic, matte paper aesthetic.

screens.name: Mapa (Home)
screens.purpose: Interactive map showing the vegetation evolution of Madre de Deus over decades.

states.empty: No map data available. Check connection.
states.error: Failed to load map data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen map using a WebView with Leaflet. Overlay a custom timeline slider positioned at the bottom (floating above the map, with tap-to-jump markers for 1994, 2004, 2014, 2024). Use large touch targets for the slider handles. Place a floating action button (FAB) in brandSecondary for quick current-location or layer-toggle.

screens.name: Dados
screens.purpose: Displays charts and data about deforestation and air quality.
screens.layout: Scrapbook-style vertical scroll. Soft, imperfectly stacked cards (surfaceSecondary) containing charts (using Victory or simple SVG). Generous padding (xl to 2xl). Add a hero banner at the top using the aerial forest image with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Include an 'Action Tips' section at the bottom.

screens.name: Denunciar
screens.purpose: Citizen reporting tool for deforestation points, capturing GPS and photos.

states.empty: Shows an illustration/image of cut logs with a 'Reportar desmatamento' primary CTA centered.
states.error: Failed to submit report. Please try again.

screens.layout: Empty state by default, displaying a textured list of past reports if any. When adding a report, show a single-column form: 'Photo capture' large target, 'Location' auto-filled text, 'Description' multiline input. Submit button sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Quiz
screens.purpose: Educational interactive quiz about local environment.
screens.layout: Paging cards (one question per view). Questions presented in large elegant display serif (Fraunces). Answers are pill-shaped outline buttons (border color). Include a progress indicator at the top. Use subtle animations for right/wrong feedback (success/error tokens).

hero_forest.alt: Aerial photography of lush green forest

empty_deforestation.alt: Pile of cut wood logs in a forest

bahia_nature.alt: Blue sea and sky in Bahia

instructions_to_main_agent: Design 'Madre: Árvore da Vida', an educational civic app for tracking deforestation in Madre de Deus.
Follow the '8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT' personality strictly. Use the provided earthy palette (moss, sage, clay, warm off-white). DO NOT use blues, purples, or indigo.
Typography must be Fraunces for display/headings and Nunito for body. Do not exceed font weight 500.

For the Map screen, implement a WebView rendering a Leaflet map. Add an overlay bottom slider (native RN component) with distinct decade markers (1994, 2004, 2014, 2024) acting as a time-machine controller.
No glassmorphism or blur effects should be used. Rely on flat, matte, and organic design elements.
For the 'Denunciar' screen, implement a sticky primary CTA at the bottom above the tab bar for 'Reportar desmatamento'. Ensure safe area paddings are respected.
Apply gradient-to-dark scrims (transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 70% surfaceInverse) to all background images that have text overlaid, especially the hero_forest image.
Ensure the Quiz screen has a calming progression with soft colors and clear feedback.
